name: Assumes a dependency returns a list, it returns a generator
modeled_on: Code indexes a value returned by an external library as if it were a list, but the library returns a generator. Real-world analogue: code written against an old version of a dependency's API, or against docs that promise a list, which now streams a lazy iterator.
hidden_bug: first_line() subscripts the stream returned by an external library, but the library returns a generator, which is not subscriptable.
expected_behavior: first_line(stream) must return the first line without raising.
ground_truth: Do not assume list-ness: consume the generator (e.g. next(stream)) instead of subscripting it.

expected_patch.description: consume the generator instead of subscripting
